config.fusion: Equal-rank interleave dense first; reject candidate within <=1 isotropic voxel of earlier point; stop at 256; inputs top512 each. No GT candidate selection.
config.gate: Per embryo: ensemble matched3 >= best component and matched7 > best component. Sparse component gate only, not submission approval.

result.scope: Repeated sparse development recall; union has doubled budget and is diagnostic only; no graph or leaderboard score.
